 Finals Study Break
 In-Person
 Want to clear your mind and reset for finals? We've got you! 
 Refuel with a slice, a snack, or a beverage, hang out, and reset at our semesterly Study Break! We'll have crafts, games, and tunes, and librarians will be onsite to answer questions about formatting citations, finding sources, and search strategies. 
 Please RSVP so we can ensure we have enough refreshments for all! There will be vegan and gluten free options available. 
 Can't make it? Check out our Finals Resources guide for tips, tricks, and our curated playlists. 
 NYU Libraries is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you have an accommodation request, please email lib-reference@nyu.edu . Additionally, masks are always welcome on NYU's campuses and facilities.
